scenes.tts: Bergmann built one of Europe's premier protein laboratories inside a leather-research institute — because leather is collagen, and collagen is protein.
scenes.visual: portrait inset; leather-research institute lab; leather = collagen = protein chips
scenes.narration: Bergmann built one of Europe's premier protein laboratories inside a leather-research institute — because leather is collagen, and collagen is protein.

scenes.tts: Then in 1933 the Nazi state expelled him for being Jewish, and he rebuilt at Rockefeller, carrying the carbobenzoxy protecting-group chemistry and a conviction most chemists did not yet share: that proteins had readable sequences.
scenes.visual: timeline 1933 expelled -> Rockefeller; carbobenzoxy chip; conviction readable sequences
scenes.narration: Then in 1933 the Nazi state expelled him for being Jewish, and he rebuilt at Rockefeller, carrying the carbobenzoxy protecting-group chemistry and a conviction most chemists did not yet share: that proteins had readable sequences.

scenes.tts: But a sequence could not be read, he was certain, until its alphabet had first been counted, so he set new recruits to the unglamorous arithmetic of naming every amino acid in a protein and in what amount.
scenes.visual: alphabet counted before sequence read; name + amount table schematic
scenes.narration: But a sequence could not be read, he was certain, until its alphabet had first been counted, so he set new recruits to the unglamorous arithmetic of naming every amino acid in a protein and in what amount.

scenes.tts: He framed it in terms they did not forget — the amino acid analysis of proteins, he told them, bore the same relationship to these macromolecules that elementary analysis bore to the chemistry of simpler organic substances. When Moore arrived in 1939 he found Stein already at the bench, and Bergmann told them to combine their efforts.

scenes.tts: Bergmann died in 1944, before Sanger's insulin sequence proved him right. The quiet lab his two recruits inherited went on to win the Nobel he did not live to share.
